# PlutarchPages

> A fork of PdfCraft: a clean-room PDF application in pure Rust for macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD
> and the web, aiming at Adobe Acrobat Pro parity. It is alpha: pages are still drawn by the `hayro`
> crate, and editing existing text, OCR beyond Latin script and Office import and export are thin or missing.

This fork publishes no builds of its own; build it from source with Rust 1.90 or later, for example
`git clone https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages` and then
`cargo run --release -p pdfcraft -- some.pdf`. The program, crates and binaries keep their `pdfcraft` names.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages#readme): features, fork changes, getting started and licence.
- [Development](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/development.md): environment variables, logs and diagnostics.
- [Roadmap summary](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): stage, parity numbers and progress log.

- [MCP conventions](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): the opt-in `pdfcraft-cli mcp` server.
- [Interface language](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/localization.md): choosing the interface language and what each catalogue covers.
- [Editing images](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/editing-images.md): moving, resizing and deleting figures.
- [Editing several objects](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/editing-multiple-objects.md): moving several objects together.
- [File format parity](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/file-format-parity.md): formats read and written.
- [PDF specification parity](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/pdf-spec-parity.md): ISO 32000-2 and subset standards coverage.
- [UI parity](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/ui-parity.md): tools, panels and shortcuts against Acrobat Pro.
- [Hardware and platform parity](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/hardware-parity.md): hardware features per platform.
- [Localization parity](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/localization-parity.md): per-language interface status.
- [Contributors](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/contributors.md): how the About window credits contributors.
- [Releasing](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/docs/releasing.md): the release workflow.
- [Attribution](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md): every bundled asset with its author, source and licence.
- [Agent and contributor rules](https://github.com/EquityBot/PlutarchPages/blob/main/AGENTS.md): asset, clean-room and safety rules.
